# sspi_role_binding (Resource)

Grants one or more roles to a remote (LDAP) user or remote (LDAP) group on the SSPI appliance.

**Local users cannot be granted roles through this API** — `POST /sspi/iam/role-bindings` only accepts `REMOTE_USER`/`REMOTE_GROUP` entities; use `sspi_user_password` for local account password management instead.

`Update` performs a full replacement of `roles` (not a merge) — any role currently held but omitted from the config is revoked.

Corresponds to `POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /sspi/iam/role-bindings[/{binding-id}]`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_name` (String) The user or group being granted roles. For LDAP users and groups this is typically the principal name returned by `GET /sspi/iam/ldap-identity-sources/search`.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles to grant to `entity_name` (e.g. `ENTERPRISE_ADMIN`, `AUDITOR`, `SUPPORT_BUNDLE_COLLECTOR`). On `Update`, this list fully replaces the entity's existing roles.
- `user_type` (String) Whether `entity_name` identifies a remote LDAP user or a remote LDAP group. Must be `REMOTE_USER` or `REMOTE_GROUP` — `LOCAL_USER` is rejected by the API for this resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the role binding, generated by the API.
